item.title: Hong Kong: AI Partnership Accelerates Smart City Solutions
item.description: Hong Kong Science Park partners with a leading regional tech firm to strategically advance smart city innovation through AI-driven 3D mapping, urban intelligence systems and enhanced public safety solutions.

item.title: Vietnam Launches Southern Cybersecurity Hub to Boost Resilience
item.description: Vietnam has officially launched the NCA southern branch in Ho Chi Minh City to strengthen cybersecurity, protect children and vulnerable groups and support the safe growth of its digital economy.

item.title: Singapore: New Standard for Smart Hospital Infrastructure
item.description: Singapore’s launch of the Healthcare Facility Design Standards (HFDS) modernises hospital development by leveraging technology, digital tools and design innovation to build smarter, faster and more efficient healthcare facilities.

item.title: Malaysia and Japan Strengthen High-Tech Collaboration
item.description: Malaysia deepens cooperation with Japan in AI, green innovation and digital development, supporting national goals and strengthening its role in the Indo-Pacific technology landscape.

item.title: Indonesia: Smart Tech, Innovation Key to a Sustainable Future
item.description: Indonesia is leveraging digital innovation, AI and smart technologies to strengthen water, food and energy security, enhancing efficiency while driving sustainable development and climate resilience.

item.title: Victoria Advances Smart Farming with Virtual Fencing for Cattle
item.description: Victoria has approved a regulatory framework for virtual fencing, enabling cattle farmers to adopt GPS-enabled smart livestock systems that support modern precision agriculture while prioritising animal welfare.

item.title: The Philippines: Promoting Digital Literacy and Inclusion
item.description: DICT-CAR is expanding partnerships with government agencies, LGUs and universities to enhance digital literacy, ICT skills and inclusive access, empowering communities and promoting gender equality in the Cordillera region.

item.title: Hong Kong: CUHK Drives AI and Robotics Innovation
item.description: Autonomous robots tackling complex real-world outdoor challenges highlight Hong Kong’s drive to advance AI, robotics, and innovative smart city technologies, enhancing resilience and sustainability across urban infrastructure.

item.title: Vietnam: Championing Smart Agriculture and Digital Innovation
item.description: Farmers in Vietnam engaged in a 2025 dialogue focused on advancing digital transformation, smart technology and innovative solutions to build a modern, resilient, and sustainable agricultural sector.

item.title: Singapore: AI, Data and Computing Drive Next-Gen Scientific Discovery
item.description: Singapore is strengthening its research agenda under the RIE2030 plan by expanding investment in AI, data and advanced computing to accelerate scientific discovery and real-world innovation.
